title: Prototype ZomBite Arena – zombie roguelite where you infect humans (feedback welcome)
author: Trashy_io
selftext:
Here’s my current prototype: ZomBite Arena – a browser-based zombie arena roguelite. 

This is my first all in solo project where I've put all that i've learned from 6-7 months of programming and AI/LLM courses and YouTube videos. All the art in the game besides the sound effects and music was generated by me with a mix of chatGPT and Gemini. 

You play as mutating zombie:

• Run around an arena

• Lunge at humans 

• Infect ability with cool down

• Survive waves as long as you can

• Between waves, pick a Mutation upgrade

• When you die, the run resets

Play in browser (no download):

👉 https://trashyio.itch.io/zombite-arena

(Working on mobile browser optimization currently so desktop only atm of writing this post) 

Id like some feedback on whats working for the game and whats not and if it's worth to keep working on.

My high score if you want to try and beat it- Wave: 12 - Best Combo: 57 (Proof on itch page lol) 

\-Merry Christmas!!

\~Trashy.io

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body:
I’d love feedback on:

	•	How the movement + lunge + infect feels
	•	Whether the Mutations feel different/interesting
	•	Anything that’s confusing, janky, or clearly the next thing to fix
